content.caption: Xiaoye spent three hours staring intensely at the empty cardboard box, waiting for a grand entrance. Instead, he just realized he forgot where he put his favorite catnip mouse.
content.scene: A hand-painted book illustration of Xiaoye, a solid black short-haired cat with bright green eyes and a tiny white chest patch, sitting upright in a sunlit living room. He looks startled yet dignified, staring blankly at an empty, crumpled delivery box. Natural morning light streams through a nearby window, highlighting his sleek fur and precise anatomy.
content.topic: The quiet dignity of a lost toy
